reponse: The root cause was the disk filling up on Kafka broker ingest-kafka-2 after infra PR #221 removed size-based retention, leaving only 7-day time-based retention. The broker went read-only at 09:38 UTC, and consumers stalled for 2h47m [2][4]. An early hypothesis blamed PR #388's batch size change, but the postmortem calls it a red herring and says the batch size was re-applied [5]. Reverting it did not reduce the lag [3]. The earlier notes that named #388 are therefore outdated [1]. Action items include an 80% disk alert and restoring size-based retention [5].
